correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the symmetrization on quotient Lipschitz seminorms; exact pair distance classes and total-variation duality give all five operator contributions. Their affine lower envelope is attained by explicit positive weights for n>=4, with a separately proved n=3 case. The n>=4 leftover inequality simplifies to sqrt(6)>=1+sqrt(2), and the analytic monotonicity follows by differentiation. Finite independently unsymmetrized LP cross-checks for n=3..6 passed. Boundaries n=3 and n=4 and all integers greater were explicitly treated; no finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: A natural mesh refinement: all edge midpoints of a regular simplex must be interpolated simultaneously by one linear rule. The exact operator norm differs from the ordinary arithmetic midpoint rule, and the separate triangular regime is forced by the appearance of disjoint-midpoint pairs in n>=4. The optimal map is positive, depends analytically on dimension, and has a sharp nontrivial limit. These are structural differences and not a routine substitution into a known one-point formula.
